vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At the vulnerable landing e23b19309b8705b21c3b3ff4129c9974ba15a419, runtime media_io_kwargs can retain backend=deepstream because backend_requires_gpu() defaults unknown names to False and DeepStream is only an inner codec of the opencv loader. The DeepStream path accepts request pool_size for a process-wide DecodePool and discards probe_metadata width/height without _check_frame_pixel_limit(), enabling unauthenticated GPU work and pixel-limit bypass. The vendor advisory describes the same three dependent causes.

atomic_bic.evidence: 9dbcf8c3d5de23925195bac6217fc85df6e8bb71 is the smallest reconstructed PR #42424 member that adds DeepStreamVideoBackendMixin, request-controlled pool creation, the opencv-loader mixin, and the vulnerable backend == deepstream branch. Local all-ref -S searches first find these mechanism strings at this member, followed by the default-branch squash e23b19309b8705b21c3b3ff4129c9974ba15a419.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC has the single parent 091d13976c1c246714bb2112dd2e208561dda6a3; bounded git grep of that parent finds no DeepStream or DeepStreamVideoBackendMixin source. The default-branch squash parent f36284a8d21d3748df30c8f1b30357be711350b5 also has no DeepStream while already containing backend_requires_gpu(), the request override gate, _check_frame_pixel_limit(), and a GPU-required PyNvVideoCodec registration.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: e23b19309b8705b21c3b3ff4129c9974ba15a419 is a one-parent GitHub squash for PR #42424. The clone retains 9dbcf8c3d5de23925195bac6217fc85df6e8bb71 on refs/pull/42424/head history. Later feature-branch members fd5b08f3f4d74c5bcb2a1594791f6287406e2930, ac550ed2cd113afa08481f118533f273e1917d79, and e004fafea2cf52a313c0a32eec6762263870c0ea only adjust typing, formatting, and an int conversion; none adds GPU registration or a pixel-limit call.

affected_release_membership.evidence: The landing squash is absent from v0.25.1 and is an ancestor of v0.26.0, v0.27.0rc1, v0.27.0, and v0.27.1. Peeled v0.26.0, v0.27.0, and v0.27.1 trees contain the DeepStream branch but no register_gpu_codec("deepstream") and no DeepStream _check_frame_pixel_limit() call.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: d83eb0b36bfbe26fc856ffdb60f05c8bd460f2fd is not an ancestor of v0.26.0, v0.27.0rc1, v0.27.0, or v0.27.1; it is an ancestor of v0.28.0rc1 and v0.28.0, whose tree contains both DeepStream GPU-codec registration and the pixel check. Thus the vendor/CVE metadata claiming patched >=0.27.0 conflicts with Git tag contents, as the primary record already states.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: The direct landed fix d83eb0b36bfbe26fc856ffdb60f05c8bd460f2fd adds register_gpu_codec("deepstream"), calls _check_frame_pixel_limit(_w, _h), strips runtime pool_size, and adds policy tests; its parent 4635cc3e8f609755ad45f9fc2cdb54fa7552038e still has the vulnerable branch without those guards. The combined PR members 37aeb3b970f01090ef56295b003cea5f3161ae25 and a3b13ffed286819aa4e6ca4c54ddd4919cf05ffb have the same stable patch-id as the landed squash.

findings: Independent clone replay confirms AI_ROOT_CAUSE: the Claude-marked atomic PR member first wrote all three dependent DeepStream mechanisms, and its immediate parent lacks them.

The vulnerability is present in v0.26.0 through v0.27.1 and the verified direct fix first appears in v0.28.0 release tags; the primary record correctly preserves this source-versus-advisory release discrepancy.
Clone evidence was complete and non-shallow: all BIC, parent, squash, fix, fix-member, and selected release-tag objects resolved locally.
